earnings.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
highlights: Revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago
Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion, up 110% from a year ago

SANTA CLARA, Calif.—Nov. 17, 2026― NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported revenue for the third quarter ended October 25, 2026, of $115.8 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago.
For the quarter, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 74.8% and 74.9%, respectively.
In September 2026, NVIDIA’s Board of Directors approved an increase of $150 billion to the company’s share repurchase authorization, without expiration.

quotes.text: Our momentum is real. NVIDIA is an exceptional technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of our people.
quotes.by: Colette Kress, interim CEO and executive vice president and chief financial officer of NVIDIA

outlook: Revenue is expected to be $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be between 71.0% and 72.0%.
GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $11.0 billion and $10.7 billion, respectively.
For the full year fiscal 2027, NVIDIA expects GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates to be between 16.0% and 18.0%, excluding any discrete items and material changes to NVIDIA’s tax environment.
